gotchas: Parked here rather than on solark-hybrid-rtu-v1 because V1.4 writes only "Outdoor Sol-Ark 5K, 8K & 12K" with no -1P/-2P suffix anywhere in the document, and Sol-Ark ships two outdoor 5 kW units. Assigning the wrong one costs a bench day, which is exactly what the rule against family-name inference exists to prevent.

What is missing: a vendor document that writes "5K-1P" (or "5K-1P-N") next to a register map, or an implementation reading a 5K-1P. Sol-Ark's own 5K-1P-N manual points at support@sol-ark.com for the map.

The specific worry is not academic. The V1.4 map is built around split-phase L1/L2 (regs 150–151, 154–155, 157–158, 160–161, 164–165, 167–168, 173–174, 176–177, 179–180).
